notes: Corrected the two 'the right/left side' phrases: the article on the attributive (הַיְמָנִית, הַשְּׂמָאלִית), which modifies the construct כֶּתֶף, takes the phrase's 'the' under rule 47 even though the head noun is a construct; the construct keeps only 'side' and no 'the' is supplied on it. Rectum articles keep the 'the' before 'house'.
